title: Order-Load Credit on Limit-Review Claims for Cartwise Grocery Orders
content:
**Order-load credit on limit-review claims.** On Cartwise Grocery Orders, the limit-review claim amount carries an order-load credit read from the refunds and review requests already on the order:

1. When the order carries at least 2 item refunds for missing, damaged, wrong-item or quality issues and at least one submitted over-cap review request, the credit is 2.00.
2. When it carries at least 2 such refunds and no submitted over-cap review request, the credit is 1.00.
3. Otherwise there is none.

The credit is added to the claim amount after that amount has been rounded to the cent.

**What is counted.**
- *Item refunds for issues:* the item refund entries on this order whose refund reason is missing, damaged, wrong item or quality, each entry counted once. Refunds for any other reason (substitution price protection, weight overage and the rest) are not counted.
- *Over-cap review requests:* the review requests on this order of the "refund over cap" type whose status is submitted.

### Decision table

| Issue refunds on the order | Submitted over-cap review requests | Order-load credit |
|---|---|---|
| 2 or more | 1 or more | 2.00 |
| 2 or more | none | 1.00 |
| 0 or 1 | any | none |

### Boundary cases (hypothetical orders)

- One damaged refund and one quality refund, plus one submitted over-cap review request: 2.00.
- The same two refunds with no over-cap review request: 1.00.
- One missing refund and one weight-overage refund, plus a submitted over-cap review request: only 1 issue refund counts, so no credit.
